claims: SpaceX has not announced an official, finalized IPO date.
Reports as of April 1, 2026, suggest SpaceX has filed confidentially with the SEC.
Reports as of April 1, 2026, suggest SpaceX is targeting a public listing as early as June 2026.
SpaceX is seeking a valuation approaching $1.75 trillion.
SpaceX has not publicly confirmed the timeline.
